task: Enforce a 60% included-allowance operating policy for the paid $5 Workers plan and continue backend calibration offline without overage risk.
nonGoals: No frontend/shared dependency changes, paid overages, external paid APIs, unrelated resources, merge or production deployment. No live metered experiment without independently reviewed account allowance evidence and reservation.

outcomes.description: Versioned 60% policy and atomic multi-metric budget reservations prevent optional audit work when allocation or evidence is missing, stale, exhausted or contradictory.
outcomes.evidence: Frozen concurrent boundary, malformed/stale cycle, missing evidence, failures and no-network scenarios with real local SQLite.

outcomes.description: Submission, polling, maintenance and inference use explicit bounded accounting; no network/model work is admitted through missing budget controls. Stable service responses explain paused audits.
outcomes.evidence: Service and inference regressions including cached reads and maintenance. No false promise of account-wide hard billing cap.

outcomes.description: Continue backend extraction protocol correctness and offline complete-report calibration without changing gold judgments or enabling an uncalibrated model.
outcomes.evidence: Frozen valid/malformed model protocol cases and independently reviewed complete fixture.

process.description: Separate plan commit, Terra implementation/review, genuine evaluation, handoff and hosted draft CI; no deployment or unrelated changes.
process.evidence: Git history, traces, independent review and PR checks.

process.description: Explicitly disclose account-wide billing blind spots; missing Billing Read cannot be treated as available headroom. Preserve daily and subscription-cycle boundaries and no-refund reservations.
process.evidence: Cost policy, safe disabled defaults, permissions evidence and documented activation prerequisites.

styleEfficiency.description: Keep one reusable policy and atomic ledger; avoid unbounded housekeeping or duplicate AI attempts.

exitTest.reason: AGENTS.md standing cost boundary changes; a fresh Terra agent must continue from only exported state and repository files, preserving disabled-default and no-unrelated-service rules.
